_comment: A worked example of foreman/config.json - a real single-repo setup (the linkding Django app) with generic Jira-side values. Fill in foreman/config.json itself by running scripts/factory-init (or by hand per SETUP.md); use this file only as a reference for what a completed config looks like.

project_routing.ENG: All product engineering - bugs, features, and enhancements to the target repos are filed here

warpdotdev-demos/linkding.description: linkding — self-hosted bookmark manager. Python/Django backend with server-rendered templates plus a small JS/Svelte frontend (bookmarks app: bookmarks, tags, archive, REST API, importers, UI). All product changes go here.
warpdotdev-demos/linkding.test_guidance: pytest on Django with SQLite (no external services); tests live in bookmarks/tests/test_*.py — add a failing-then-passing test there and run 'uv run pytest bookmarks/tests/<file> -n auto' scoped, then the full gate. Run 'make init' once to set up (uv sync + migrate + npm install).
warpdotdev-demos/linkding.app_start_command: make init && uv run manage.py runserver 8000
